$comment:
This repository's own plugin catalogue, hosted in the tree rather than anywhere else, so a session gets its plugins from the same commit as the code they act on — nothing to publish, nothing to keep in sync, and a change to a plugin is reviewed in the pull request that makes it.

Registering it is a ONE-TIME act by each developer, and it cannot be checked in: `claude plugin marketplace add ./.claude/plugins` (or `/plugin marketplace add ./.claude/plugins` in a session). `.claude/settings.json` carries the `enabledPlugins` entry, which IS honoured at project scope, so nothing else is needed after that. `extraKnownMarketplaces` is deliberately NOT set there — measured against Claude Code 2.1.222, that key is read from user, flag and managed settings only and skipped in project and local settings, so a repository cannot make a checkout run plugin code its owner never agreed to. Setting it here would be a config that silently does nothing.

Claude Code ignores manifest keys it does not know (`claude plugin validate` says so in as many words), which is where this note lives; the same convention as `coverage.config.json` at the repo root.
